result.summary: The landlord approved a plumber visit up to £150 and asked for Brightwell Plumbing (event 004), but the booking email bounced (event 006) and the tenant update failed to send (event 008). I assigned Brightwell, emailed the tenant to say sorry and how to stop the water, and escalated at high priority so a person can phone Brightwell and fix the email address on file. The visit is still not booked.
result.situation: The bathroom basin tap at 3 Kestrel Close is leaking and the puddle is getting bigger. The job was approved 3 days ago but nobody was told: the contractor never got the booking and the tenant never got the update. The tenant has now chased.

judgement.why_this_decision: The approval is clear and names a contractor (event 004), so assigning Brightwell is the normal next step. But the only Brightwell address on file bounced (event 006, probably misspelt 'brightwel'), so I have no working way to reach them. A person needs to phone them. The tenant is unhappy and there is some water risk (classify_reply: dissatisfied 0.94, safety 0.67), so they needed a reply and safe advice now.

alternatives_considered.option: Message the contractor through the CRM
alternatives_considered.why_not: The only address on file bounced, so the message would fail again.

alternatives_considered.option: Treat as an emergency and send any plumber
alternatives_considered.why_not: A basin tap drip can be stopped at the isolation valve, so it is not water that can't be contained. The landlord also named a contractor.

alternatives_considered.option: Ask the landlord for approval again
alternatives_considered.why_not: Approval is already given up to £150.
